task:
Create and modify Services of different types.

In namespace 'pluto':

  1. Create namespace 'pluto' if it does not exist.

  2. Create a Pod named 'project-plt-6cc-api' in namespace 'pluto':
     - Image: nginx:1.17.3-alpine
     - Labels: project=plt-6cc-api

  3. Create a ClusterIP Service named 'project-plt-6cc-svc' in namespace 'pluto' that:
     - Targets pods with label project=plt-6cc-api
     - Maps port 3333 (service port) -> 80 (container port)
     - Type: ClusterIP

  4. Test the service (from within the cluster):
     kubectl run test-curl --image=nginx:alpine --rm -it --restart=Never -- curl project-plt-6cc-svc.pluto.svc.cluster.local:3333
     Save the response to /opt/course/10/service_test.html

  5. Convert the Service to NodePort type on nodePort 30333:
     kubectl edit service project-plt-6cc-svc -n pluto
     Change type from ClusterIP to NodePort and add nodePort: 30333

Verify:
  kubectl get svc project-plt-6cc-svc -n pluto
  kubectl get svc project-plt-6cc-svc -n pluto -o jsonpath='{.spec.type}'  # NodePort
  kubectl get svc project-plt-6cc-svc -n pluto -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].nodePort}'  # 30333
hints: To change type: kubectl edit svc project-plt-6cc-svc -n pluto  or kubectl patch
